name: nested_consolidation_probe_preflight_v1
scope: 25 fixed previously seen cases and each case prior20 through next5 common sessions; no economic run, ranking or optimized thresholds.
formula: At close t, old block[t-20,t-11], recent block[t-10,t-1]. U0=maxH old,L0=minL old,U1=maxH recent,L1=minL recent,V0=median amount old,V1=median amount recent. Nested=(U1<=U0 and L1>=L0 and U1-L1<U0-L0). Dry=(V1<V0). Local break=(C_t>U1). Candidate=nested and dry and localbreak. Incremental early=(candidate and C_t<=max(U0,U1)). Exact10/10 splits inherited20day reference; zero/natural order boundaries, no tuned cutoffs.
purpose: New local consolidation breakout event below the older20day high can invite an independent small probe, not PVR/DMI/Qrange score modification and not an added gate to original births. Current first probe routes remain unchanged. Not a certified VCP or supply-exhaustion measure.
consumer_draft: Unimplemented market contract only: original AB/PRICE priority and existing births preserved. A new candidate may create a local root with old known local floorL1 and a next-common-open-only receipt if no existing position/parent/unsettled obligations. One small target under unchanged original budget/risk. Root only fails at close<=oldS, no same-day re-open; no permanent blacklist, no fixed cooldown, fresh later preparation may reenter. Existing root/parent prevents duplicated probes; new frontier receipts follow original target/ACK responsibility. Profit-before-add unchanged; no added confirmation waiting gate. Exact union/collision/financial consumer requires a separately frozen implementation, not simulated here.
postbreak: Only report observed subsequent close relative to fixed candidateU1 and localL1, next day onwards. Not used to certify birth or select fixed cases; no new retest score/gate. Current cumulative amount never called inventory or net flow.
known: 21 consecutive common sessions; price positive and valid, raw/native coherent; no source_kind/path/segment change, factor constant; prior20 amount positive and volume eligible; no dropna clock. Unknown separate.
duplicate: PriorJ:two realized legs plus volatility/amount ratio. PriorZ:fixedI-root first retest unit amount. PriorA:age weighted historical bar relative current price. LER:shortrest then yesterdayHigh insideE0. This tests two completed nested10bar price boxes and prebreak amount contraction, withoutE0 requirement; not first use of consolidation or volume contraction.
limits: Known outcomes of fixed cases already seen; nonPIT/static pool; day-level fills/ACK unknown; no strategy win rate, filtering PnL, threshold sweep or full account.
clock: Candidate requires tclose, earliest next-commonOPEN. No future prices used in calculation.
